reviews_5s:
Me encantó el producto. El pilón es amplioI’m really happy with my purchase of the IMUSA Wood Mortar & Pestle. The X-Large size is just right for grinding larger quantities of herbs, spices, or making pastes. The wood is solid and durable, and the pestle fits comfortably in my hand, making it easy to crush ingredients. I use it almost daily for making salsas, spice blends, and even pesto. It’s sturdy enough to handle tough ingredients without any wobbling. It’s easy to clean, though I always ensure to rinse it immediately after use to preserve the wood. This is a fantastic, functional kitchen tool that’s built to last.10/10This is your product if you’re looking for, Mofongo maker for your houseLa madera salió pequeñaTHE WOOD IS ROUGH. I KNEW THAT FROM OTHER REVIEWS.
I SANDED WITH 80,100 AND 150 GRIT. THEN I FILLED IN A SMALL SPLIT ON THE OUTSIDE WITH GLUE AND SANDING RESIDUE. WHEN THAT DRIED I SANDED IT LIGHTLY.
THEN I OILED IT 3X WITH FOOD GRADE MINERAL OIL.
I NOW HAVE A MIGHTY NICE LOOKING AND STURDY MORTAR AND PESTLE FOR $20.!!
I'm happy!Perfecto para hacer tu mofongoIf you love making pesto, mofongo, hummus, or anything with smashed garlic etc. this is for you. I toss iti n my dishwasher and it cleans right up. 10/10 recommendI bought this for a gift for my sister and she loves it and so do I it looks very good strong and will hold up for a long timeLove how big it is! It’s also deep so when your crushing garlic or any other spice, it stays in the mortar. Great price and quality.
reviews_1s:
It broke after the first use.

I’ve owed this before and know how to care for it yet it broke right down the middle.I normally love Imusa products, but I was disappointed with this one. I checked the product and it seem to have been in great conditions until I noticed it started leaking. There was a crack barely visible on the inside but as I looked closer realized it was Crack all the way to the bottom which was the reason it was leaking. Poor packaging as well.This product is nothing like the photos or description and is unusable as a food preparation item. There are large cracks, and you can see the wood filler on the side. Item is completely misrepresented and will be returned. By far the single worst purchase I’ve made in my 20 years as an Amazon customer.It had a big runny stain of varnish on it, or something. It’s not varnished or sealed. My husband who is a chef looked at it and said “that will crack, return it.” I returned it. Sorry.Arrived cracked. I did not even open the mesh-wrap. Will return it as is.Poor quality product. Photos say it all. Complete piece of junk. Save your money. Not recommended at all. Thanks that Amazon accepts returns, but they should have some kind of quality control. Buyer beware - NOT made of solid wood instead made of crappy wood and glued pieces.I haven't been home to use it and when I tried to I noticed that it is split so I can't use it and the return window closed. So it is useless I was looking forward to using it.I didn't listen to other reviews. I should have sent it back immediately when I saw the wood knot in the base. After second use (on Easter, 1 day post being able to return), it fully cracked. Poor quality.It's useless and the seller sells false thingsPicture looks so much better than the actual product. I didn’t even get a lid. Also, the product looks like they just finished cutting the wood or something. Very disappointed ☹️
